note: Style/taste registry — what ZavodOM's visual taste already knows across 4 axes (design, cinema/DP, color-LUT, montage). The style Scout dedups new web findings against this before proposing a GATED card. Mirrors known_capabilities.json so lib/scout.py helpers (known_ids/is_new) work directly. Mature entries get a card in skills/zavod-craft/style-library/.

design_styles.essence: refractive translucent material, edge lensing, specular sheen, layered depth
display type as the hero, cropped letterforms, tight tracking
hard borders, solid offset shadow, clashing saturated color, mono font, zero gradient
grid discipline, whitespace, serif+sans hierarchy, pull-quote, asymmetric balance
chrome/metallic, blobby shapes, holographic gradient, lens-flare, sparkle
rounded variable-size card grid, one info per cell, modular/scannable
matte-clay soft renders, pastel, floating abstract objects, not photoreal
reduction, one focal point, limited palette, generous negative space (discipline under all)
2026 wave: imperfect, scratchy linework, texture+warmth, proof a human made it

cinema_dp.essence: natural/practical light, subtle camera moves, restrained painterly palette (Blade Runner 2049, 1917)
natural light only, long uninterrupted takes, wide immersion (Revenant, Birdman)
close-up lens choices, dark palette, crafted bokeh, intimate
underexposure, soft painterly light, skin in shadow (Arrival)
high-contrast, deep shadow, muted/monochromatic mood, mystery
gothic, dark-romantic, deep shadow + intricate light (del Toro)
ARMENIAN: frontal tableau, static symmetry, folk-iconographic saturated ritual color (Color of Pomegranates)
ARMENIAN: 'distance montage' theory — recurring motifs across distance, rhythm over linear cut
ARMENIAN-Canadian: fractured timelines, cool distance, voyeur framing, memory/grief

color_luts.essence: 2026 #1: film-stock emulation, grain+halation, rich reds/yellows, high-contrast blacks
still the commercial-king cinematic look; use deliberately, not by default
subtle desat for tension; color as emotional response, not look-for-look
highly stylized, near-painterly palettes; signature over generic
gradual highlight compression, shadows retain detail+color, slight desat in extremes
premium B&W via channel-mixer, true blacks, preserved micro-contrast (thriller/key-art)

montage.essence: graphic/compositional match cut + spatial match — two times/places feel continuous; motivated, geometric, elegant
ARMENIAN: separate key shots by distance, let recurrence build meaning rhythmically
2026: clean, let content breathe, no thousand-cut over-edit
grain, dust, jitter, fade, light leaks, film burns
sound-led whip/snap cuts, kinetic comedic rhythm
elliptical, sensory, sound-image association over plot continuity
